steps.title: Get a Forestry kit. — Go …
steps.text: Get a Forestry kit. — Go to the Forestry world 444 and do events during all of the upcoming Woodcutting segments. — Keep any leaves you get in the kit

steps.title: Start The Giant Dwarf for access …
steps.text: Start The Giant Dwarf for access to Keldagrim. — Remember you can get to the Blast Furnace with the minigame teleport or the GE minecart

steps.title: Smith an inventory of Steel bars …
steps.text: Smith an inventory of Steel bars at the Blast Furnace. — Just pay the fee. — Withdraw 5 with the withdraw X option. — Use the nearby bucket spawn and water source to cool the bars

steps.title: Quickly train to level 26 Construction …
steps.text: Quickly train to level 26 Construction with Mahogany Homes. — Use beginner contracts to level 20, then oak to 26. — Buy an Adamant axe from Lunami's Axe Shop. — If you are not 31 Woodcutting get a Mithril axe as well to use until then. — Use the Auburnvale sawmill. — Don't overthink this, it should only take a few contracts.

steps.title: Chop Logs and fletch them into …
steps.text: Chop Logs and fletch them into 900 arrow shafts

steps.title: Complete The Tourist Trap. — Buy …
steps.text: Complete The Tourist Trap. — Buy 15000 feathers from Shantay. Fletch 900 headless arrows for the 10 Fletching. — Put the xp reward on Fletching

steps.title: Chop more logs and Fletch them …
steps.text: Chop more logs and Fletch them into 14100 arrow shafts. — Start with Oak logs and then switch to Willow logs at 30 Fletching. — Make headless arrows as you go to get 30 faster. — After you are done, you can death pile and let the Forestry kit despawn on the ground. If you do it this way, it will keep the bark you have collected. — You can quickly die by picking nettles at the Draynor Village Jail and also tanking a guard there.

steps.title: Continue with the guide questing and …
steps.text: Continue with the guide questing and fletch your 15000 headless arrows as you walk around

steps.title: Once you have finished making those, …
steps.text: Once you have finished making those, head to Hickton's Archery Emporium and purchase 15000 Steel arrowtips. — Purchase 250 per world. This will only cost about 200k total

steps.title: Then you will continue questing as …
steps.text: Then you will continue questing as before and fletch 15000 Steel arrows. — You should end with at least 50 Fletching. — Drop the arrows once finished, they are just for the xp

steps.title: Make Rings of Dueling and a …
steps.text: Make Rings of Dueling and a Games necklace for teleports and to restore run energy at the Ferox Enclave. — The Gold bars can be tele-grabbed in the Varrock West Bank basement. — Buy the gems and other supplies in Al Kharid. — Make 3-4 rings at a time and restock when you run out. — Just make 1 necklace and wear it, you don't use that one as often.

steps.title: Fish
steps.text: Fish

steps.title: cook there until you reach 35 …
steps.text: cook there until you reach 35 Fishing
steps.note: 3-tick fly fish trout/salmon at a static spot (e.g. SE of Prifddinas) for fastest XP; Tempoross is a good no-tick option from 35.

steps.title: Put all of your coins in …
steps.text: Put all of your coins in the coffer at the Ferox Enclave

steps.title: Drop any runes and items you …
steps.text: Drop any runes and items you have on you for a clean inventory. — Keep your Ardougne Cloak, boots of lightness, staff of air, and jungle camo

steps.title: Head to Tempoross. Train there until …
steps.text: Head to Tempoross. Train there until at least level 53 Fishing. — Make an effort to repair the masts and totems as much as you can. — Complete all of the combat achievements except Dress Like You Mean It and Why Cook?. — Don't bother cooking. You are here for the Fishing and Construction xp, not the loot. — Going higher than level 53 is perfectly fine if you would like.

steps.title: After you are finished, pull all …
steps.text: After you are finished, pull all your loot. — Drop all the Spirit flakes. — Open and sell the loot from any Caskets at the Rogues Den. — Drop any Soaked pages unless you get a Tome of water. — Drop the Fish barrel if you get it. — Drop the Tackle box if you get it. — Drop the Big harpoonfish if you get it. — Sell the Dragon Harpoon if you get it unless you want to do 2t harpoon fishing in the future or more Tempoross. — Keep the Tome of water if you get it and put your pages in it for now. — It is up to you if you want to keep this longer-term. It is nice sometimes, but not critical. — Cook and drop all the fish at the Rogues Den. — Drop the Seaweed, Steel nails, Feathers, and Fishing bait. — Use up all the planks at your house, you can quickly unnoted them at Phials.
